alinti.alinti: the Sire of Athens owed him allegiance for Nauplia and Argos alone

ek_alintilar.alinti: Othon de la Roche received Argos and Nauplia as fiefs of the principality of Achaia
who governed Argos and Nauplia for his cousin, the Duke of Athens
which, during the Catalan period, had remained loyal to the family of Brienne
the Lady of Argos transferred her Argive estates to Venice
Venice acquired the sole remaining dependency of the old French duchy of Athens
Malipiero persuaded the people of Nauplia to admit him as the representative
It was not till 1394 that Venice at last obtained possession of that coveted city

not: 1280: Atina dukunun (Guy/John I de la Roche; John 1280'de oldu, s.140) Akaya'dan fief'i; Jacques de la Roche valiydi. Baslangic: Larissa(Argos) 1212'de alindi, Othon fief'i odul olarak aldi (Miller 'in 12 12', OCR; fief yili ayrica yazilmaz, 1212 ima). Katalan donemi (1311-) Nauplia/Argos Brienne ve varisi Enghien'de kaldi (Argos-Nauplia lordlugu: Marie d'Enghien, kocasi Pietro Cornaro). Marie 1388'de Argolis'i Venedik'e satti (yillik 500 duka); Nauplia'yi Venedik komiseri Malipiero devraldi (kesin devir ayi/yili yok); Argos'u Despot Theodore bir sure tuttu, Venedik ancak 1394'te aldi (Thermisi, Kiveri ile). Miller 1388-89 icin ayri 'edinis' yili vermiyor; Nerio'nun Eylul 1389 tutuklanmasi Argos'a baglanir (s.342 civari).

alinti.alinti: Othon de Cicon, the Burgundian baron of Castel Rosso, held out for long against a combined attack by land and sea

ek_alintilar.alinti: Ignoring the assignment of Oreos and Karystos to Venice by the treaty of partition
led, in 1296, to the renewal of hostilities between the former and the Greek Empire
henceforth, in fact, as well as in name, the prime favourite of Duke Guy of Athens was baron of Karystos

not: Karystos Licario'nun dogum yeri; Licario once Othon de Cicon'dan (Frank baron, Castel Rosso) aldi, Mihail VIII onu butun adaya fief yaptı (s.137). Alim yili Miller'de YOK (Demetrias deniz savasi ve Licario'nun yukselisi 1277 baris oncesi; yil yok). 1280'de adanin Chalkis disi Licario/Bizans elinde (s.141). 1296'da Bonifacio da Verona Karystos'u, Larmena ve Metropyle ile geri aldi; esi mirasi olarak Karystos baronu (s.209). Terzieri: Boniface Karystos'u Ravano'ya verdi (s.44-45), bunlar kağıt uzerinde Venedik payiydi.

alinti.alinti: Oreos was taken, and he seized and fortified the castle of La Cuppa

ek_alintilar.alinti: supported by the Greek fleet at Oreos
Boniface invested Pegoraro with the north
to repel a Genoese attack on the fortress of Oreos

not: Oreos Pegoraro'nun kuzey baronlugu (terziere). Licario aldi (yil yok); 1270'ler sonunda Rum filosunun ussu. Geri donus yili Miller'de verilmiyor; 14. yy.'da Venedik kalesi (s.301 Cenevizli saldirisi, Venedik kalesi). 1280'de Bizans (Licario) tarafindan tutulan kuzey Eğriboz; 1280 tam gun teyidi yok, Miller 'outside Chalkis he was master of the island' (s.141) der.

alinti.alinti: Over the three central islands of Cephalonia, Zante, and Ithaka, there now ruled

ek_alintilar.alinti: they were in the possession of a Count Maio, or Matthew, a member of the great Roman family of Orsini
Count Maio, or Matthew, Orsini, who ruled over Cephalonia and Zante
like his father Matthew, a vassal of the Prince of Achaia
deposing the Orsini dynasty

not: 1280: Palatin Kont Richard Orsini, Akaya Prensi'nin (dolayisiyla Napoli kralı Charles'in) vassali; Anjou dogrudan degil. Baslangic: Miller Orsini'yi IV. Haclı Seferi'nde (1204) Kont Maio/Matteo olarak tutuyor, Normanlar (Margaritone) 20 yil once adalari Bizans'tan ayirmisti; Orsini'nin kesin ilk yili yok (1185/1194 Miller'de YOK). 1207 Innocentius III'e, 1209 Venedik'e bagliligini bildirdi (s.46). Bitis: 1324 John of Gravina Orsini hanedanini azletti (s.260). Ithaki ismen s.151-152.

alinti.alinti: While Leukas still remained united to the Despotat of Epiros

ek_alintilar.alinti: His eldest son, Nikephoros I., succeeded to Old Epiros and the island of Leukas
it appears to have belonged to the despots of Epiros
as belonging to John of Cephalonia

not: 1280'de Epiros Despotlugu (Nikephoros I). Orsini'ye gecis 'a little before the year 1300' (Charles II belgeleri; kesin yil yok), s.181. Miller Leukas'in 1264 Kefalonya envanterinde yer almadigini ve 1300'de Richard'in oglu John'a ait oldugunu cikarim olarak soyler.

alinti.alinti: the vassal of the Emperor and captain of Cerigo

ek_alintilar.alinti: he drove the Venieri from their island of Cerigo
it remained in the possession of his family till 1309
restored Cerigo, with the approval of Venice, to the Venieri
Cerigo had passed into the hands of the great Monemvasiote family of Daimonoyannes, with whom it remained for forty years

not: Venier'ler Licario'nun akininda adadan atildi (yil yok); Paul Monoyannes (Daimonoyannes) 1275'te 'imparatorun vassali ve Cerigo kaptani' (Venedik belgesi). Adada once Monemvasia'dan vali gonderildi. 1309'da Rum ve Latin lordlarin cocuklarinin evliligi ile Venier'lere dondu. 1280'de Bizans (Monoyannes). Cerigotto: Viari de atildi.

alinti.alinti: by 1207 Sanudo and his comrades had conquered a duchy

ek_alintilar.alinti: Two dynasties alone
the Sanudi and their vassals the Ghisi, remained in the whole Archipelago
The Ghisi were driven from Amorgos, Seriphos, and Keos
the Duke of Naxos was deprived of Ios, Siphnos, Sikinos, and Polykandros
were ousted from Astypalaia
freed his native island of Anaphe from the Foscoli
the Barozzi recovered Santorin and Therasia, the Ghisi and their fellows Amorgos, Keos, and Seriphos
recaptured the island of Ios for the Duke of Naxos
In 1307 a whole batch of islands was recovered by the Latins
in 13 10, the Quirini, aided by another Venetian family, the Grimani, recovered their lost island of Stampalia

adalar_1280_ilk_liste_s44: Naxos, Paros, Antiparos, Kimolos, Melos, Amorgos, Ios, Kythnos, Sikinos, Siphnos, Syra (dukalik); alt-fief: Andros (Marino Dandolo), Anaphe (Foscolo), Santorin (Barozzi), Astypalaia (Quirini), Tenos+Mykonos+Skyros+Skopelos+Skiathos+Seriphos+Keos (Ghisi)

licario_kaybi.miller_ifadesi: yil yok; 'Ten other islands ... lost for twenty years or more' (s.577); 1277 ve 1285 baris antlasmalari Sanudi+Ghisi'yi koruyor (s.578); geri alinis 1303 antlasmasiyla (s.582)

not: Miller 'Amorgos' dahil 'Ten other islands' der; 1280'de Licario akininin etkisi (Karystos/Eğriboz, Cerigo, Ege) 1280 oncesi ve sonrasinda surer; 1280-01-01 icin Naksos dukalik cekirdegi (Naksos, Paros, Antiparos, Kimolos, Melos, Kythnos, Syra, Andros) Marco II elinde; Amorgos/Seriphos/Keos/Ios/Siphnos/Sikinos/Astypalaia/Anaphe/Santorin 1280'de Licario donemine ait kayip olabilir (kesin yil yok -> null). Melos'ta Rum isyani bastirildi (s.576-577).
